276419.notes: Rate measured in logs (EV-0003). Spell-table hit (spell hit, spell crit x1.5, resists), no spell power scaling (SPCoef 0). Binary: the hit roll carries the whole resist, no partial resists. VERSUS: base damage x2 against Undead (row VersusMobTypes). Holy has no resistance.

279852.name: Rock on Stick
279852.notes: Rate measured in logs (EV-0050). The application rolls the melee special table without a crit and the bleed lands only if it does; bleed ticks ignore armor. When a main-hand white swing of this weapon triggers it, the landed strike is a main-hand special that rolls main-hand weapon procs once more (R-0040, EV-0145); in the off hand it never does. 10 ticks; ticks cannot crit.

281665.name: Twilight Forgehammer
281665.notes: Rate measured in logs (EV-0136). Spell-table hit (spell hit, spell crit x1.5, resists), no spell power scaling (SPCoef 0). The row carries main-hand proc flags, but it is registered as a weapon proc, so the hand holding the mace decides.

286430.name: Toofbreaker
286430.notes: Rate measured in logs (EV-0136). Physical strike on the melee special table (miss, dodge, parry, block; melee crit x2; armor applies). When a main-hand white swing of this weapon triggers it, the landed strike is a main-hand special that rolls main-hand weapon procs once more (R-0040, EV-0145); in the off hand it never does. icd 100 ms is the row's own cooldown, so a Toofbreak never brings a second one. Tooltip "2 times as much damage if the target is facing you" (dummy effect 2) is NOT applied by the reference.
